contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ DN VALENS P F AVG ; R/ [GL]ORIA [ROMANORVM]

An incomplete, Roman coin, copper alloy nummus of Valens, AD 364-78. Mint unclear. Reece Period 19. Obverse description: Diademed bust facing right. Obverse inscription: DN VALENS P F AVG. Reverse description: Emperor standing with standard, going right, dragging captive on left. Reverse inscription: [GL]ORIA [ROMANORVM]. Diameter: 17.78 mm; Thickness: 1.37 mm; Weight: 2.41g; DA=6
